subject.title: fix(mcp): honor `disabled` flag to prevent spawning disabled servers

question: Should OpenClaw retain `enabled` as the sole supported MCP enablement setting, or intentionally add and support `disabled` as a lasting public alias?
rationale: This branch changes the public configuration contract, and repository policy favors canonical runtime shapes with compatibility repair in doctor/migration code; the preferred permanent contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep one canonical setting
options.body: Reject the runtime alias and preserve `enabled: false` plus a doctor migration path for old configuration files.

options.title: Support the alias deliberately
options.body: Accept `disabled` as a public contract only with an explicit compatibility policy, conflict precedence, documentation, and complete canonicalization coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical setting
recommendation.body: Reject the runtime alias and preserve `enabled: false` plus a doctor migration path for old configuration files.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent MCP schema work makes them the closest available routing candidate for the configuration-contract decision.
